chars.ADAM: ADAM: a 16-year-old Moroccan boy with short curly black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one wide black stripe across the chest, light blue jeans, white sneakers, a grey school backpack
chars.YASSIN: YASSIN: a tall skinny 16-year-old Moroccan boy with a buzz cut, wearing a bright red football jersey with a white number 10, black track pants with white side stripes
chars.NADA: NADA: a 16-year-old Moroccan girl, top of her class, long black hair in a high ponytail, round gold glasses, wearing a lavender cardigan over a white shirt, holding a school notebook
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan man in his fifties with a thick grey moustache, grey flat cap, beige zip jacket, a Casablanca taxi driver

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In front of a Moroccan public high school gate in a working-class Casablanca neighbourhood, afternoon. YASSIN grabs ADAM's arm excitedly and points down the street, shouting with joy. ADAM's laughing smile freezes into a nervous, awkward look, one hand on his empty pocket. Comic tension. Both fully visible in the centre, calm street background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same school gate in Casablanca. NADA jumps in between the two boys, cheerful and confident, holding up her notebook. YASSIN cheers. ADAM swallows and looks sideways, embarrassed. Comic awkward moment, three teenagers in the centre.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On a Casablanca sidewalk, ADAM pretends to be cool, waving his hand dismissively and making a bored face, while NADA and YASSIN look at him surprised. Comic body language, sunny street, parked red petit taxis in the background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot on the sidewalk: NADA raises an eyebrow, arms crossed, skeptical. ADAM leans toward her, finger raised, arguing with exaggerated confidence. Playful tension between them, both faces clearly visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Flashback inside a modest Moroccan family living room with a sedari sofa: DAD comes home in the evening proudly holding up a plain brown paper bag, three happy children jump around him cheering. Warm lamp light, joyful family moment. No logos.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Back on the Casablanca sidewalk: ADAM stammers and sweats, hands miming the shape of a long sandwich, forcing a smile. NADA and YASSIN lean in curiously, trying to understand. Comic awkwardness.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of NADA and YASSIN staring at ADAM with suspicious narrowed eyes, NADA tilting her head asking a question. ADAM in the foreground, frozen, eyes wide, a drop of sweat on his forehead. Comic suspense.
